project_type: Laravel 11 tutoring platform (PHP 8.4), Blade + Alpine.js frontend, MySQL database
build_system: Composer + npm (no build step needed for plan; artisan commands are the primary toolchain)
test_framework: None configured — verification is via `php artisan migrate`, `php artisan route:list`, and `php artisan optimize:clear`
test_command: php artisan route:list --name=bookings && php artisan route:list --name=admin.manual
verification_instructions:
1) Run `php artisan migrate` — expect 'Nothing to migrate' or successful migration output.
2) Run `php artisan route:list --name=bookings` — must include bookings.payment-status.
3) Run `php artisan route:list --name=admin.manual` — must include admin.manual-payments, admin.manual-payments.verify, admin.manual-payments.reject.
4) Run `php artisan optimize:clear` — expect 'Application cache cleared' with no errors.
5) Manual smoke test: visit /tutors/{slug}, book session, enter code, confirm pending UI appears.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell — use semicolons instead of && to chain commands. DB is MySQL on 127.0.0.1:3306, database=tutor_platform, user=root, no password. APP_URL=https://mwalimu.ovaldesk.co.ke. Never restart a dev server.
contribution_requirements: All PHP files must use strict typing conventions matching the existing codebase. No new packages to install. Keep DarajaService intact (only comment out STK Push usage). Do not delete IMBankPaymentController or IMBankService.
key_patterns: Controllers inject services via constructor. BookingService::confirmBooking() handles session codes + Jitsi URL + wallet credit + notifications. Notifications extend Illuminate\Notifications\Notification, use ['database','mail'], have toMail() and toArray(). Admin controllers live in App\Http\Controllers\Admin\. Admin views extend 'layouts.admin'. Alpine x-data on booking wizard tab-book div. Payment model status enum includes pending/success/failed/refunded — needs pending_verification added. Route model binding on Booking uses 'uuid' (getRouteKeyName). Payment uses default 'id'.
directory_structure: app/Http/Controllers/ — web controllers; app/Http/Controllers/Admin/ — admin controllers; app/Services/ — service layer; app/Models/ — Eloquent models; app/Notifications/ — Laravel notifications; database/migrations/ — migrations named YYYY_MM_DD_HHMMSS_description.php; resources/views/pages/ — Blade views; resources/views/pages/admin/ — admin views; resources/views/layouts/admin.blade.php — admin layout with sidebar nav; routes/web.php — all web routes; routes/api.php — Daraja/IMBank API callbacks; .agents/tasks/ — plan and verdict files
